mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.item_id, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, o.price, o.message, o.status, o.meet_place, o.created_at, o.confirmed_at, o.finished_at, i.title AS item_title, i.images AS item_images, b.nickname AS buyer_nickname, s.nickname AS seller_nickname
FROM cb_order o LEFT JOIN cb_item i ON o.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN cb_user b ON o.buyer_id = b.id LEFT JOIN cb_user s ON o.seller_id = s.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cb_order (order_no, item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, price, message, status, meet_place,created_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{price}, #{message}, #{status}, #{meetPlace}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE cb_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.item_id, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, o.price, o.message, o.status, o.meet_place, o.created_at, o.confirmed_at, o.finished_at, i.title AS item_title, i.images AS item_images, b.nickname AS buyer_nickname, b.school AS buyer_school, s.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM cb_order o LEFT JOIN cb_item i ON o.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN cb_user b ON o.buyer_id = b.id LEFT JOIN cb_user s ON o.seller_id = s.id WHERE o.item_id = #{itemId} AND o.status = #{status} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
